regression.rule: A measured p75 or p95 regression fails when it exceeds both the multiplier and absolute guardrail. Counter and client-JavaScript regressions use their multiplier guardrail.

notes: The server-duration targets retain the investigation-spec targets; PERF-002 supplies the first local distribution for deciding whether they are realistic.
Route SQL and database-unit ceilings are current-baseline guardrails rounded up by approximately 20%; they are not optimization targets.
The homepage reporting-write budget is intentionally zero even though PERF-002 observed one projection, because GET must become read-only.
Client JavaScript caps use the 102 kB shared and 121 kB largest-route production baseline; route-specific output should be measured when the build reporter exposes it.
The small-import benchmark currently measures preview, not save. The small-import-save target remains the investigation target and is not claimed as measured by PERF-002.
